The `owes <member>` command works, and a borrow is refused when the member owes more than 5.00, including for staff. No staff exception was built because R3 conflicts with other rules. `dotnet test Lending.slnx` passes (25 tests), and the work is committed as `64f6377`.
I left out the rejected DEC-W-4. Instead the money-owed check runs after every existing borrow refusal, so those keep their current messages. That placement is a new, still-proposed decision (DEC-W-7) the gate has not checked; if it's rejected, moving one line in `src/Lending.Transition/Loans.fs` changes it.
The order question and the R3 conflict are open questions for the owners in `.work/report.json`.
